profile: Transit architecture and stations, large. Owns the client relationship and most of the corridor, which is exactly why it assumes the tunnelling half is somebody's problem already.

projects.title: Riverside Interchange Station
projects.narrative: Below-grade interchange station with a new concourse, two island platforms and a full-height light well over the trackway.

projects.title: Eastline Extension Stations Package
projects.narrative: Four elevated stations along a light rail extension, sharing platform canopies and a common vertical circulation kit.

projects.title: Central Terminal Concourse Renewal
projects.narrative: Concourse renewal at a commuter terminal, delivered in six-week possessions around a running timetable.

projects.title: Calder Bus Rapid Transit Corridor
projects.narrative: Bus rapid transit corridor with median stations, signal priority and a maintenance depot.

projects.title: Northbank Deep Stormwater Store
projects.narrative: Deep stormwater storage driven through soft ground beneath a dense riverfront district, with three drop shafts and a screening chamber.

projects.title: State Archive and Records Centre
projects.narrative: Environmentally controlled archive with high-density storage, reading rooms and a conservation laboratory.

projects.title: Airport Automated People Mover
projects.narrative: Automated people mover linking three terminals, with elevated guideway, four stations and a maintenance facility.

projects.title: Regional Rail Operations Control Centre
projects.narrative: Operations control centre for a regional rail network, with a video wall, dispatch floor and a hardened data room.

projects.title: Harbour Ferry Terminal
projects.narrative: Ferry terminal with six berths, a waiting concourse and an integrated bus interchange.

projects.title: Network Security Hardening Programme
projects.narrative: Security hardening across an operating network; the alignment, the sites and the scope are covered by a non-disclosure protocol and cannot be described.
